nearbyScopeReview.specificConclusion: Nearby painting/equal-gap, parity-distance, singleton, Euler construction, narrow-grid plug DP and prefix-sum articles do not contain the required complete operations. General algorithm or helper reuse is not verified coverage.

1116.reason: The intervening lighter color forbids joining the two 2 strokes.

1117.reason: Ordinary root distances discard odd-walk feasibility.

1118.reason: Bipartite-level formulas miss allowed loop/internal terminal choices.

mathematicalReview.1116: Same-color links are allowed precisely across strictly darker interior positions. They form chains; restricted components give strokes=vertices-links. A monotone stack produces linear links, and right-endpoint sweep counts contained links.
mathematicalReview.1117: Connected undirected graphs with N>=2 allow every same-parity length after the minimum by two-step backtracking. Sorted minima retain parity through integer parity. Legal A/B/C edges plus decreasing-distance predecessor witnesses characterize realization; the root zero-distance exemption, absent buckets, greedy continuation and terminal loop/edge pairing agree.
mathematicalReview.1118: Layer independence, required nonzero rows/columns in B-edge matrices, compulsory A predecessors and terminal loop-allowed non-isolation PIE are consistent. Terminal PIE independently checked over every loop-allowed graph N0..5 and all designated-prefix requirements.
mathematicalReview.1140: A triple fixes its delegation endpoints. Both endpoint breeds must be unique in the entire interval. Before adding the right endpoint, the suffix of active left endpoints times interior singleton count is exact; the previous two occurrences yield the stated +1/-1 intervals.
mathematicalReview.1141: Local bijections represent trails plus independent cycles. Every cycle contains a backward edge, so at most two unfinished paths need tracking. Self closure and double cross closure are forbidden; other crosses merge. Remaining local choices contribute (degree-tracked)!. The 0/1/2-hit state split gives O(N^3), not a naive O(N^5) transition bound.
mathematicalReview.1142: Consecutive overlapping row intervals are equivalent to connectivity; left valley/right peak endpoints are equivalent to column convexity. Strict inward changes uniquely determine phase switches. Transition inequalities intersect into constant-many rectangles and yield O(N^3) time with rolling O(N^2) memory.

1116.oracle: BFS from all-zero fence, enumerate EVERY legal contiguous brush stroke of colors1..3 (never decrease any cell), then compare minimum action counts. No monotone-stack oracle.

1117.oracle: Enumerate EVERY labeled graph including loops/no parallel; group by the COMPLETE eventually-periodic sequence of literal exact-length reachable vertex bitsets (cycle detection, not an arbitrary length cutoff). Min edge count over the entire group is independent oracle for greedy.

1118.oracle: Group size in the same exhaustive infinite-language partition is independent graph-count oracle; compare bipartite formula, layered two-stage PIE, root exemption and independently derived terminal C-edge/loop PIE. Exact integers, not modulo coincidences.

1140.oracle: Enumerate ALL ordered-by-position leader triples l<m<r; directly count each leader breed in ENTIREdelegation l..r. Compare literal active/singleton interval-update equations (not a production lazy API), also check every intermediate active/weight invariant.

1141.oracle: For EVERY eligible graph, local degree balance uniquely determines S/R/. roles. Enumerate actual sender-to-unusedreceiver edge-disjoint directed TRAILS in fixed sender order, permitting repeated vertices, stopping at receivers optionally, accepting iff EVERY edge used once. Compare two-backedge frontier DP including single-path cycle closure, cross merger, double cross closure, receiver termination and deg-minus-tracked factorial.

1142.oracle: Enumerate actual cell subsets and test literal occupied-row contiguity, occupied-column contiguity,4-neighbor BFS connectivity. Compare endpoint/unimodality characterization for EVERYsmallshape. Zeta sum over allvalidsubsets gives exact answer for eachgrassboard, independently checked against interval/two-strict-phase-flags DP. No prefix-sum optimization/API implemented in this research probe.
